description: Create a new OAuth2 client bound to a treasury (treasury SSOT for redirect/branding per API 0.1.0)

parameters.name: treasury
parameters.description: Treasury contract address to bind this client to (bindedTreasury). Redirect and branding come from on-chain treasury params.

parameters.name: redirect-uris
parameters.description: DEPRECATED — ignored if provided. Set redirect_url on treasury (verona-treasury) before create. CLI prints [WARNING] on stderr; exit 0 if otherwise valid.
parameters.notes: Do not teach agents to rely on this field. Use treasury update-params + sync-from-treasury instead.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: DEPRECATED — ignored on create; authenticated user becomes owner. CLI prints [WARNING] if provided.

parameters.name: client-uri
parameters.description: DEPRECATED — ignored if provided. Set display_url at treasury create (--config) or on-chain, then sync-from-treasury. CLI prints [WARNING] if provided.

parameters.name: logo-uri
parameters.description: DEPRECATED — ignored if provided. Set icon_url on treasury and run sync-from-treasury. CLI prints [WARNING] if provided.

parameters.name: json-input
parameters.description: JSON file with full request body (bindedTreasury required). Chain-mapped keys redirectUris, logoUri, clientUri, owner are deprecated — stripped with [WARNING] on stderr.

parameters.name: show-secret
parameters.description: Show client secret in output (default: redacted)

validation_rules: treasury (bindedTreasury) is required — set redirect_url and icon_url on treasury before create (verona-treasury update-params or create); display_url at create if needed
redirect-uris is NOT required and must NOT be taught as SSOT
Deprecated chain-mapped flags/JSON keys are warn + discard before HTTP; success JSON on stdout is unchanged
contacts must be valid email addresses when provided
If --json-input is provided, all other flags are ignored

errors.remediation: Re-authorize with xion:mgr:write scope (--dev-mode or full OAuth)
Provide --treasury with a valid Xion address
Only the treasury admin can create clients

workflow: verona-toolkit oauth2 client create --treasury xion1abc... --client-name My DApp

examples.description: Legacy flags still accepted but ignored (stderr [WARNING])
examples.note: Redirect did NOT change via CLI — update treasury on-chain and run sync-from-treasury
